lookup.hint: Type or scan the accession and press Enter.
lookup.emptyMessage: Enter an accession to see the visit's account and collect payments.
account.title: Visit account
account.billedThroughClaims: This visit belongs to a lab-to-lab batch: it is billed to the sending laboratory through claims.
payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Collect the patient share of a visit, in full or in part, on a treasury approved for this device.
pay.title: Take a payment
pay.referenceHint: Card slip, POS or transfer number; required except for cash. Never the card number.
pay.noTreasury: No treasury is approved for you on this device.
pay.nothingDue: Nothing is due on this visit.
void.title: Void the payment
void.message: Void receipt {number} of {amount}? The amount returns to the balance. A reason is required.
refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.subtitle: Return a negative balance (after a contract transfer or a cancelled service), never above the refundable amount.
refunds.emptyMessage: Enter an accession to see the refundable amount of the visit.
refund.title: Refund
refund.done: Refund {number} recorded; print the receipt for the patient's signature.
refund.nothingRefundable: Nothing is refundable on this visit.
refund.reasonsError: The refund reasons could not be loaded.
batch.title: Batch payment
batch.subtitle: Settle the members of a group batch one by one or all at once.
batch.lookupHint: Type the batch number and press Enter.
batch.emptyMessage: Enter a batch number to see its members, their shares and balances.
batch.noMembers: The batch has no member visit.
batch.labToLab: A lab-to-lab batch is billed to the sending laboratory through claims; no payment is taken here.
batch.payAllHint: The amount is distributed in accession order, up to each member's remaining balance.
closing.title: Cash closing
closing.subtitle: Reconcile the drawer of a treasury for a cashier and a period: expected cash = cash payments − cash refunds.
closing.toHint: Movements up to, not including, this time.
closing.equation: Expected cash = cash payments − cash refunds; card, POS and transfer amounts are not in the drawer (BR-16).
closing.noteHint: Required when the counted cash differs from the expected cash.
closing.confirmMessage: Close treasury {treasury} with expected cash {expected} and counted cash {counted}? The period is frozen afterwards.
closing.done: Closing {number} recorded; print the handover sheet.
closing.overlaps: A closed period of this treasury overlaps the chosen period; choose another period.
closing.truncated: Only the first 2,000 movements are listed.
collections.title: Collections report
collections.hint: Whole laboratory days, 00:00 to 23:59. The default is today for your own payments; the amount of every payment method is shown.
collections.equation: Net = posted payments − refunds; voided payments are not counted.
collections.todayOnly: Your role may report on today only.
collections.earliestHint: Your role may report from {day} onwards.
collections.beyondLimit: The period starts before the earliest day you may report on.
collections.invalidPeriod: The end of the period must not precede its start.
